---
name: quality-assurance
description: Validate functionality, responsive behavior, accessibility, security and build quality.
---

# Quality Assurance Skill

1. Translate requirements into observable acceptance criteria.
2. Inspect changed files and adjacent flows for regressions.
3. Run existing lint, type, test and build commands; never invent test results.
4. Check keyboard use, focus, labels, contrast, reduced motion and responsive layouts.
5. Check map rendering, attribution, loading/error states and graceful failure.
6. Review secrets, input validation, unsafe rendering and dependency changes.
7. Report severity, evidence, reproduction steps and remaining risks.
